title: Operator Certification and Knowledge Transfer Protocol for Private Deployments
author: Priya Patel
content:
Overview
This document defines the Operator Certification and Knowledge Transfer Protocol (OCKTP) for Redwood Inference private deployments (VPC and on‑prem). The OCKTP standardizes how we train, assess, and evidence operator readiness for installation, day‑2 operations, upgrades, and safe rollbacks so customers receive consistent operational capability during handoff. It complements deployment runbooks and field playbooks but focuses on people/process artifacts, concrete evaluation criteria, and retention policies.

Scope
- Audience: Field operators, SREs, Solutions Engineers, Professional Services engineers, and third‑party operators contracted by customers.
- Coverage: VPC commissioning, air‑gapped on‑prem packaging, day‑2 operational tasks (telemetry, KV cache migrations, tenant failover), and upgrade/rollback scenarios.
- Not covered: Deep model tuning or customer application code (those are covered in customer onboarding docs).

Goals
1) Provide a reproducible certification path (Fundamental -> Advanced -> Operator‑Instructor).
2) Define practical exam scenarios tied to real incidents and SLOs.
3) Capture evidence templates and artifacts required for customer handoff and compliance.
4) Establish renewal cadence, remediation steps, and escalation contacts.

Definitions
- Operator: Individual responsible for running and troubleshooting the private deployment runtime.
- Certification Badge: A named badge (Fundamental, Advanced, Instructor) representing a passed assessment.
- Evidence Bundle: A collection of logs, screenshots, and signed checklists required to demonstrate proficiency for a specific customer engagement.

Certification Levels and Criteria
1) Fundamental (operator can safely commission and perform steady‑state tasks)
   - Duration: 1 day classroom + 1 day lab (8 hours total instruction, 8 hours practical).
   - Required knowledge: network basics (BGP/VPC peering), SSH/RBAC, KMS basics, telemetry retention.
   - Practical pass criteria (all must be demonstrated):
     a) Complete a preflight checklist and explain three network isolation patterns (split‑horizon, proxy fabric, tenant VLAN).
     b) Boot a small on‑prem appliance image and confirm service start within 7 minutes.
     c) Execute a safe model artifact refresh using the staging insert flow and confirm KV cache warmup within two successful test requests.
   - Validity: 12 months.

2) Advanced (operator can run upgrades, rollback, and perform complex recoveries)
   - Duration: 2 days classroom + 2 day lab.
   - Required knowledge: rolling upgrade strategies, KV cache migration, multi‑zone failover, capacity throttling, and cost controls.
   - Practical scenarios (must pass at least 4 of 5):
     a) Execute an orchestrated, zero‑traffic canary upgrade across two zones and produce the rollout evidence bundle.
     b) Perform a KV cache migration (incremental) with no query loss and document the snapshot/rollforward commands executed.
     c) Simulate an intermittent WAN degradation and apply tenant‑level graceful degradation policies to meet 95% success rate for high‑priority routes for 15 minutes.
     d) Reproduce a degraded GPU thermal event in the lab and validate failover to preemptible capacity while maintaining latency SLO for <100ms tail for 99th percentile (lab target).
     e) Demonstrate a safe rollback from a model swap that introduced regression in quality (use provided eval harness to show baseline vs current).
   - Validity: 18 months.

3) Operator‑Instructor (can train and certify others)
   - By invitation; requires Advanced plus observed delivery of two certification workshops and signoff by two instructors.
   - Responsible for local evidence custody and for approving customer‑facing Evidence Bundles.

Training Curriculum (modules)
- Module 0: Intro & Redwood private deploy philosophy (30m).
- Module 1: Network and security primitives for VPC and air‑gapped sites (2h).
- Module 2: Packaging and immutable images for on‑prem (1.5h) — includes attestation and signing.
- Module 3: Runtime internals (KV cache, batching, model hot swap) (3h).
- Module 4: Observability & telemetry sampling (2h) — includes cost-aware telemetry sampling strategies.
- Module 5: Upgrades & rollback patterns (2.5h) — hands‑on checklist review.
- Module 6: Incident simulations & failure drills (4h lab).
- Module 7: Customer handoff, evidence collection, and compliance (1h).

Assessment and Evidence Requirements
- Every practical assessment produces an Evidence Bundle (zip) containing:
  - Completed checklists (signed by candidate).
  - Command transcripts and timestamps.
  - Relevant logs (systemd, runtime logs, telemetry snapshots) for the scenario window.
  - Synthetic workload results and post‑test SLO graphs.
  - Video or sequence of screenshots for any GUI steps.
- Evidence retention: Instructor retains copies for 24 months in the internal evidence vault. For customer‑facing engagements, a redacted Evidence Bundle is delivered to the CSM and stored in the project workspace.

Sample Evidence Checklist (text table)
- Preflight: network routes validated | KMS connectivity tested | telemetry pipeline sanity check | disk health OK
- Upgrade: canary deployed | canary latency < baseline +10% | percent traffic shifted | rollback trigger exists
- Rollback: artifacts restored | KV cache consistency verified | tenant routing reestablished | post‑rollback smoke tests passed

(Example checklist row shown as plain text for cut‑and‑paste use.)

Practical Exam Scenarios (concrete)
1) VPC Shadow‑deploy and Safe Failback (duration: 90 minutes)
   - Given: a customer tenant with two availability zones and active traffic at 35% of capacity.
   - Task: Deploy a shadow model variant in the passive zone, route 2% of traffic, observe traces for 30 minutes, then perform incremental shift to 25% and finally perform full cutover. Document blackbox smoke tests and abort at first sign of error rate >1.5% over baseline.

2) Air‑gapped Model Refresh (duration: 120 minutes)
   - Given: a signed model artifact bundle delivered on removable media.
   - Task: Validate signing, import to artifact registry, run offline verification, stage to canary host, warm KV cache, and validate inference correctness using local eval harness.

3) Forced Rollback After Model Quality Regression (duration: 60 minutes)
   - Given: a deployed model introduces regression on a defined prompt set.
   - Task: Run the regression evaluation suite, confirm delta, trigger model swap to previous version, collect evidence bundle, and notify the SLO owner and CSM.

Operator Tools and Commands (examples)
- Preflight network test: sudo ip route show | grep <tenant-prefix>
- Start runtime: sudo systemctl start redwood-runtime.service
- Collect runtime logs for window: journalctl -u redwood-runtime -S "2026-01-01 10:00" -U "2026-01-01 10:20" > /tmp/runtime-window.log
- Create KV snapshot (example CLI): redwoodctl kv snapshot --tenant tenant-123 --output /tmp/kv-snap-20260101.json
- Perform canary shift (kubectl example): kubectl apply -f canary-traffic-shift.yaml

Templates and Attachments
- Attachments (templates stored in Templates repo):
  1) preflight-checklist-template.md (text).
  2) evidence-bundle-manifest.json (schema), use minimal fields: candidate, scenario, timestamps, artifacts.
  3) lab-simulation-seed-workload.yaml (synthetic workload generator config).

Mapping to Customer Requirements and Handoff Process
- For every customer private deployment, the following must be included in the Handoff Packet:
  1) Certified operator roster for the engagement (names, badges, expiry dates).
  2) Redacted Evidence Bundles for the field commissioning and at least one upgrade/rollback drill.
  3) Approved telemetry SLO matrix and on‑call escalation contact list.
- Minimum operator coverage: 2 Fundamental + 1 Advanced for field engagements under SLA Tier A.

Compliance and Audit Considerations
- Evidence Bundles must avoid customer PII. Any sensitive artifacts must be redacted prior to customer delivery.
- For regulated customers (HIPAA/PCI), the Instructor must verify Evidence Bundle for compliance and mark custody with confidentiality: restricted.

Renewal and Remediation Process
- Renewal cadence: Fundamental 12 months, Advanced 18 months.
- Remediation triggers: major platform change (runtime upgrade with breaking configuration), failed on‑call episode with >1hr MTTR due to operator error, or an audit finding.
- Remediation path: targeted re‑training module + focused practical re‑test (maximum 2 attempts).

Ownership, Escalation, and Reporting
- Document owner: eng-private-deployments training cell (team owner: PrivateDeployTraining).
- Certification ops contact: training-ops@redwood.ai.
- Escalation: for failed lab safety or evidence disputes, escalate to the Platform Reliability manager (pager id: #pr-manager).
- Monthly report fields: number certified, recertifications due next 90 days, remediation actions, and incident correlation (operators involved in incidents).

Appendices
A. Sample lab workload YAML (small):
```yaml
workload:
  name: operator-cert-seed
  targets: [tenant-123]
  qps: 12
  model: rwd-open-7b-v2
  duration: 900s
```

B. Example evidence bundle manifest fields (text):
- candidate_name
- badge_level
- scenario_id
- started_at
- finished_at
- artifacts: list of filenames (logs, screenshots, transcripts)

C. Quick checklist for field installers (one page):
1) Confirm HW serials and firmware matches customer allowance.
2) Perform network ztest (verify RTT and packet loss <1% at 95th).
3) Validate KMS reachability and key policy.
4) Execute smoke start: runtime, agent, telemetry.
5) Deliver signed Evidence Bundle to CSM and attach to project workspace.

Change Log

- 2026-01-18: Revised upgrade/rollback pass criteria and added instructor path (review by Sofia Andersson).

Contact and Next Steps
- To request training delivery or schedule certification windows, open an internal ticket to team PrivateDeployTraining or email training-ops@redwood.ai.
- For updates to this protocol, submit a PR against the Templates repo and notify the reviewer alias.

Related resources (internal)

- Runtime upgrade and rollback playbooks in the eng-private-deployments upgrade-and-rollback tree.

End of document.
